name: MS RESEARCH PROJECT
description: The MSR thesis in the Department of Materials Science and Engineering involves independent, in-depth research under faculty supervision. Students formulate a materials-related research problem, conduct a comprehensive literature review, and design experimental, computational, or theoretical approaches. The work may involve materials synthesis, processing, characterization, modeling, or performance evaluation. Emphasis is placed on understanding structure–property–processing–performance relationships, data analysis, and research ethics. Students present periodic progress reviews and submit a written thesis, culminating in a viva-voce examination to demonstrate originality, critical thinking, and technical competence in materials engineering.
